description: KLA Corporation and its majority-owned subsidiaries are suppliers of industry-leading equipment and services that enable innovation throughout the electronics industry, providing advanced process control and process-enabling solutions for manufacturing wafers, reticles and masks, chemicals and materials, integrated circuits, packaged integrated circuits and printed circuit boards, as well as comprehensive support and services across its installed base. Its suite of advanced products, coupled with its unique process control software and services, allows it to deliver solutions that help customers achieve their technology advancement and high-volume production goals by improving yields while reducing waste, risks and costs, improving customers' overall profitability and return on investment, and its services business accounted for approximately 23 percent of total revenues in fiscal 2026.
